hebrewText: וּ/דְבַ֣שׁ וְ/חֶמְאָ֗ה וְ/צֹאן֙ וּ/שְׁפ֣וֹת בָּקָ֔ר הִגִּ֧ישׁוּ לְ/דָוִ֛ד וְ/לָ/עָ֥ם אֲשֶׁר אִתּ֖/וֹ לֶ/אֱכ֑וֹל כִּ֣י אָמְר֔וּ הָ/עָ֗ם רָעֵ֛ב וְ/עָיֵ֥ף וְ/צָמֵ֖א בַּ/מִּדְבָּֽר

tokens.bdb: honey (from its stickiness); by analogy, syrup
a collective name for a flock (of sheep or goats); also figuratively (of men)

tokens.explanation: a collective name for a flock ; also figuratively
tokens.explanationEn: a collective name for a flock ; also figuratively

tokens.bdb: a cheese (as strained from the whey)
beef cattle or an animal of the ox family of either gender (as used for plowing); collectively, a herd
tokens.kjv: beeve, bull ([phrase] -ock), [phrase] calf, [phrase] cow, great (cattle), [phrase] heifer, herd, kine, ox.
tokens.ptLiteralWord: beef cattle or an animal of the ox family of either gender ; collectively

tokens.bdb: to be or come (causatively, bring) near (for any purpose); euphemistically, to lie with a woman; as an enemy, to attack; religious to worship; causatively, to present; figuratively, to adduce an argument; by reversal, to stand back
tokens.kjv: (make to) approach (nigh), bring (forth, hither, near), (cause to) come (hither, near, nigh), give place, go hard (up), (be, draw, go) near (nigh), offer, overtake, present, put, stand.

tokens.bdb: David, the youngest son of Jesse
tokens.explanation: David — Davi, rei de Israel, autor de muitos salmos

tokens.bdb: a people (as a congregated unit); specifically, a tribe (as those of Israel); hence (collectively) troops or attendants; figuratively, a flock
tokens.explanation: am — povo, nação, grupo de pessoas com identidade comum

tokens.bdb: who, which, what, that; also (as an adverb and a conjunction) when, where, how, because, in order that, etc.
tokens.kjv: [idiom] after, [idiom] alike, as (soon as), because, [idiom] every, for, [phrase] forasmuch, [phrase] from whence, [phrase] how(-soever), [idiom] if, (so) that ((thing) which, wherein), [idiom] though, [phrase] until, [phrase] whatsoever, when, where ([phrase] -as, -in, -of, -on, -soever, -with), which, whilst, [phrase] whither(-soever), who(-m, -soever, -se). As it is indeclinable, it is often accompanied by the personal pronoun expletively, used to show the connection.
tokens.explanation: asher — pronome relativo: que, quem, o qual, cujo

tokens.bdb: properly, nearness (used only as a preposition or an adverb), near; hence, generally, with, by, at, among, etc.
tokens.kjv: against, among, before, by, for, from, in(-to), (out) of, with. Often with another prepositional prefix.
[idiom] at all, burn up, consume, devour(-er, up), dine, eat(-er, up), feed (with), food, [idiom] freely, [idiom] in...wise(-deed, plenty), (lay) meat, [idiom] quite.

tokens.bdb: (by implication) very widely used as a relative conjunction or adverb (as below); often largely modified by other particles annexed
tokens.kjv: and, + (forasmuch, inasmuch, where-) as, assured(-ly), + but, certainly, doubtless, + else, even, + except, for, how, (because, in, so, than) that, + nevertheless, now, rightly, seeing, since, surely, then, therefore, + (al-) though, + till, truly, + until, when, whether, while, whom, yea, yet.
tokens.enLiteralWord: very widely used as a relative conjunction or adverb ; often largely modified by other particles annexed
tokens.explanation: ki — conjunção causal e explicativa: porque, pois, que, quando
tokens.explanationEn: very widely used as a relative conjunction or adverb ; often largely modified by other particles annexed
